about_the_game:
Explore the beauty and innovation of modern abstraction in the "Abstract" DLC for World of Art – learn with Jigsaw Puzzles. This carefully curated collection features 31 abstract paintings from renowned artists around the world, including Mondrian, Klee, Marasco, Gris, Kandinsky, Power, Chirico, Wawrzyniecki, Ravilious, Black, Saÿen, and Bluemner.

Each puzzle invites you to discover the unique visual language of abstraction—where color, shape, and composition take center stage. From geometric precision to emotional expression, these works offer a diverse and inspiring journey through one of art history’s most influential movements.

Add the DLC to your wishlist, follow the game for updates, and share your thoughts with the community. Your support and feedback help us grow and bring more art to life through interactive learning.
